outcome: Subsequent pregnancy within 365 days of delivery
cohort: Women who delivered at a single tertiary care center from 2012 to 2014 (n=8,394)
finding: Women who had consistent postpartum contraceptive plans were more likely to have higher parity, choose highly effective contraceptive methods, and achieve their contraception plan, but were not more likely to have a subsequent pregnancy within 365 days of delivery.
